title: Northern circuit, privately guided
blurb: Tarangire's elephants, the Ngorongoro Crater floor and the open Serengeti, with a private vehicle and one guide throughout.

title: Following the Great Migration
blurb: Camps placed where the herds are for your month of travel, from calving plains to river crossings.

title: Four days, one great park
blurb: A shorter safari that goes deep into a single park instead of rushing through several.

title: Kilimanjaro by the Lemosho route
blurb: The longer approach with time to acclimatise, a full mountain crew and a medical kit on every climb.

title: Mount Meru, then the safari
blurb: Walk Meru's crater rim first, then head into the parks with strong legs and fewer crowds behind you.

title: Island stay after the bush
blurb: Five unhurried days on the coast: a boutique stay, a dhow trip and nothing else you have to do.
